body.statement: Theorem 1 of Capitao-Miniconi, Gassiat, and Leh\'ericy states that in their two-replicate additive model, condition (H2) for each latent signal and coordinate independence (H1) for each error law make equality of observed convolution laws identify both the latent-signal law and the error law up to translation.

attestation.note: Verified against Theorem 1 in the published article; the node paraphrases its H1--H2 assumptions and conclusion.
